head_commit.message:
fix(native): fetch the Node 14/16 standalone pnpm by checksum, not curl

The w8/226 layer downloaded @pnpm/linux-* with curl inside a RUN, which
fails in a build without network (the m91 qualification builds offline)
and differs from every other generated tool fetch. It now follows the Hugo
pattern: per-architecture ADD --checksum stages selected by TARGETARCH,
unpacked by the pinned busybox, then COPY --link. Primary Node prepends
the stages before its final base; a Node companion carries them in its
primaryStage. Resolver-generated Dockerfiles rebuilt on arm64/amd64.
